tips: Collect rent before the next player rolls — or you lose it.
Unbought properties go to auction for the whole table.
With scarce inns and resorts in the bank, building turns into an auction.
Three doubles in a row send you straight to the Fort.
Trading with others can complete that color group.
Mortgaged properties collect no rent. Redeem with interest when you can.
